findings.description: enable_key_rotation is not set, so it defaults to false and the key material protecting the logs bucket is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the blast radius of a key compromise and fails common key-management baselines (a comment in the file even acknowledges rotation is off).

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS attaches the default key policy granting the account root principal full control, which in turn allows any IAM principal in the account that holds kms:* permissions to use or administer the key. There is no least-privilege restriction on who can decrypt the log data this key protects.
